title: 最優秀シニアウマ娘選出！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the end of the year approaches, I receive some wonderful news.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: As representative for the panel of selectors, allow me to humbly present this award!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on being selected for Best Senior Year Umamusume, <chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Your performance this year has been truly outstanding! I believe your running has served as an inspiration to countless others!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: To share in the excitement, I've also brought along two individuals you know very well…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: The Japan Umamusume Training Center Academy's very own Director Akikawa and Secretary Hayakawa!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I hope our appearance isn't an inconvenience. Congratulations to both of you.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: As someone deeply involved in the world of Umamusume, I agree with this wonderful selection! Wholeheartedly!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The way you two work together and soar to great heights has touched the hearts of so many.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indeed! I have no doubt you'll continue to be a driving force in the world of Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I wish you both the best in your future endeavors! Once again, bravo!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I'll continue to support you from the sidelines too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the press conference ends on a high note, <chrname> and I vow to achieve even greater glory!
